fact: Senegal launched a digital platform for obtaining the NINEA, inaugurated by Economy Minister Abdourahmane Sarr, to speed up business and association registration.

APIX says its Bureau de Création d'Entreprise, a one-stop office with the justice, finance, statistics, labour and OAPI bodies represented, formalises a firm in 48 hours, issuing the commercial register entry and tax identifier.

The EITI country page says Senegal's commercial register (RCCM) records beneficial ownership information under Decree 2020-791, available to authorities, courts and people with a legitimate interest on request, with a registry extract covering 262 companies.
ODS states that Seninfogreffe gives access to the RCCM registry information on all companies in Senegal, has digitised the archives, and lets users carry out formalities online securely.
